content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Github pages

GitHub Pages offers free hosting for static websites, while Cloudflare Pages provides a similar service with additional features like Workers and automatic SSL certificates. Both platforms are ideal for digital product stores, but their architecture differs significantly. GitHub Pages relies on JavaScript libraries like React or Angular, whereas Cloudflare Pages uses a custom-built language called Cloudflare Workers. This distinction affects the complexity and scalability of each solution.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages have different approaches to restricted countries. GitHub Pages follows the same geographic restrictions as its parent company, GitHub, which means creators in certain regions may face limitations. Cloudflare Pages, on the other hand, offers a more flexible solution by allowing creators to configure their own domain and hosting settings, making it easier to bypass restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is ownership. With solutions like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, creators maintain full control over their digital product stores, including the infrastructure and data. Automation is also a critical aspect, as it enables creators to streamline their workflows and focus on content creation. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide robust automation capabilities, making it possible to deliver digital products instantly.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages depends on specific needs and goals. If you prioritize simplicity and are comfortable with JavaScript libraries, GitHub Pages might be the better choice. However, if you require more advanced features, scalability, and flexibility, Cloudflare Pages is the way to go. Remember, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers comprehensive documentation and integration guides to help you make the most of your chosen architecture.
Is hosting on GitHub Pages free?

The most important question is: how can I choose the best architecture for my digital product store? The answer lies in understanding your specific needs and goals. Consider factors like simplicity, scalability, and flexibility, and choose the solution that aligns with your vision. With the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) as your guide, you'll be well-equipped to make an informed decision and build a thriving digital product store.
Digital creators have the power to choose their own infrastructure, not rent it from platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on building a digital product store, be sure to check out our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers a wealth of knowledge on sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, and with it, you'll be able to create a robust and scalable store that adapts to your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
